paper_metadata.title: On-Chip Ramp Generators for Mixed-Signal BIST and ADC Self-Test
paper_metadata.abstract: A practical approach to generate on-chip precise and slow analog ramps, intended for time-domain analog testing, monotonicity and histogram-based tests of ADCs is proposed. The technique uses an analog discrete-time adaptive scheme to calibrate the ramp generator. The lowest slope is 0.4 V/ms. Three implementations are presented for different levels of accuracy and complexity. Measurement results show excellent accuracy and programmability, up to only 0.6% of slope error and maximum integral nonlinearity error of 175 V. Experimental and theoretical results are in good agreement.
